title: EPL: David James hopeful of Manchester City clinching the elusive title
text:
EPL: David James hopeful of Manchester City clinching the elusive title 
 Home / Sports / Football / Article / EPL | 'I'm rooting for Manchester City...': Former England's goalkeeper David James 
 EPL | 'I'm rooting for Manchester City...': Former England's goalkeeper David James
 Updated On: 04 November, 2026 04:56 PM IST | Mumbai | mid-day online correspondent 
 Earlier, Arsenal emerged victorious by 1-0 against Liverpool at Anfield Stadium in England. Following the win, the former footballer said that the team is doing the basics right early on in the mega event
 Listen to this article : David James
 Former England 's goalkeeper David James heaped praise on Arsenal by saying that the side has been displaying a beautiful brand of football in the ongoing English Premier League (EPL).
 "Arsenal are the favourites to lift the Premier League title this year after their success last season. They are displaying a serious and beautiful brand of football, and they have lost just one game so far," he said on JioHotstar.
